# awscc_dax_parameter_group (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::DAX::ParameterGroup



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the parameter group.
- `parameter_group_name` (String) The name of the parameter group.
- `parameter_name_values` (String) An array of name-value pairs for the parameters in the group. Each element in the array represents a single parameter.
